I've reviewed w180 and it goes to you as `DONE_WITH_CONCERNS`: one finding should be fixed now. The change does what r23 asks: step 4 of `skills/formulating-features/SKILL.md` now runs the old scenario with `python3 -m pytest`. But its new way of naming that scenario usually picks out no test at all.

**Fix now (Important), `SKILL.md:26`:**
- **What is wrong:** the skill says the test name is the scenario title "lower case with underscores". pytest-bdd also drops every character that isn't a letter, digit or space: hyphens, apostrophes, slashes and backticks.
- **How often it bites:** 370 of the 470 scenario titles in `features/` contain such a character.
- **Probe:** on a supervision scenario, the name built the way the skill says collected 0 of 202 tests; pytest-bdd's real name collected 1.
- **Why it matters:** the skill's next bullet says an old scenario that is "not collected" gets replaced or removed. So a scenario that passes today can leave the suite instead of being deprecated, which formulation r4 forbids. The new "check with `--collect-only`" doesn't say what to do when it finds no test.
- **Fix:** state pytest-bdd's real naming rule, or find the node id from `--collect-only`. Also say that collecting no test, or more than one, is not a verdict: the session fixes its selection or stops.

**Minor (observation only):** `-k` matches any test whose name contains the given text. An old title's name also matches its own "(deprecated)" copy, and an outline collects one test per example. The skill doesn't say what to do when more than one test is collected; the fix above covers it.

**Could not verify:** my review session drops every scenario unless I pass `--work-item ""`. It probably inherited a `--work-item` filter from its environment, but I wasn't allowed to run `env` to confirm. If the sessions that write scenarios inherit the same filter, every old scenario reads as "not collected" and would be replaced. That isn't caused by w180, but it decides whether step 4 can work at all under `work run`.

- **Commits:** w180 has one commit, `75cd7fda`, touching only `SKILL.md`. It is the same change as the three commits the implementer reported, rebased.
- **Tests and `features/`:** nothing touched, so no test was removed or weakened.
- **Size:** the size check printed nothing.
